title: sse: fix streaming chunking & framing (partial JSON, delimiters, ordering)
author: Ava Chen
commits: 8f3c2a1 - reproduce: add e2e harness that simulates partial-frame splits
3b9a6e4 - sse: deterministic framing and buffering primitives
d1a4f7b - compat: normalize/escape framing in openai adapter
6ac4f12 - tests: add unit + integration tests for framing and ordering
4c0f5d3 - ci: add streaming e2e job and fix flakey runner
review_comments: Ethan Park: Nice repro. Two questions: can we guarantee ordering under multithreaded flush? Also please add a perf microbenchmark.
Ava Chen: Ordering is guaranteed by the reorder-safe buffer and single-writer flush hook; added a benchmark in tests/bench/test_sse_perf.py and included numbers in the PR description.
Lina Rossi: Please add a unit test for an edge-case where a closing brace is the first byte of a new event (we hit this in smoke tests).
Ava Chen: Added test_sse_framing.py::test_closing_brace_leading_event to cover that case.
Marcus Li: CI failed on linting and an unrelated flakey test; lint fixed, flakey test quarantined with an issue reference.
Ethan Park: Approving after seeing the integration test and CI green.
release_notes:
- Fix: SSE framing and chunking for streaming endpoints to prevent partial/invalid JSON being emitted to clients.
- Fix: OpenAI-compat streaming adapter normalization (data: [DONE] and delimiter handling).
- Test: Add unit + integration coverage for streaming framing and ordering.
notes: Follow-up: track ENG-4910 to add server-side metrics for 'stream.continuations' and add an SDK-level helper to reassemble continuation markers for non-compliant clients.
ci_log_summary: CI: initially failed lint (trailing commas) and one quarantined flakey test; after fixes, all checks passed including the new streaming e2e job.
